data.name: Layout_EngineDesc
data.value: Merges OCR words into paragraphs using distance thresholds

data.name: Layout_WordGapThreshold_Desc
data.value: Max gap along the baseline between words to merge into a line, in percent of word height; also snap tolerance for line ends vs the previous frame

data.name: Layout_BaselineDriftTolerance_Desc
data.value: Max drift of word centers perpendicular to reading direction to merge into a line, in percent of word height

data.name: Layout_AngleToleranceDegrees_Desc
data.value: Max angle difference for merging words into a line, lines into a paragraph, and matching a previous-frame line, in degrees

data.name: Layout_LineSpacingThreshold_Desc
data.value: Max center-to-center distance along the paragraph normal to merge lines into a paragraph, in percent of average line height

data.name: Layout_LineOverhangTolerancePercent_Desc
data.value: Merge lines if at least one stays within the other along reading; max overhang in percent of line height

data.name: Layout_VerticalColumns_Desc
data.value: Experimental. Assemble CJK glyphs (and upright punctuation/digits / square numbers) into top-to-bottom columns and read columns right to left. For manga when OCR returns characters with no rotation.

data.name: Layout_FontSizeTolerance_Desc
data.value: Max height difference between lines to still merge into one paragraph, in percent of average line height

data.name: Layout_EnableStabilization_Desc
data.value: Snap line bounds to the previous frame, smooth text flicker, and keep unmatched paragraphs as ghosts

data.name: Layout_HoldNewBlocks_Desc
data.value: Hold a paragraph until its original text matches the previous frame, or until the previous paragraph was already shown and the normalized text is similar (within the text match threshold)

data.name: Layout_CenterThresholdXPercent_Desc
data.value: How far past the previous line ends to still match a word, in percent of line height

data.name: Layout_CenterThresholdYPercent_Desc
data.value: How far off the previous baseline to still match a word, in percent of line height

data.name: Layout_LevenshteinThreshold_Desc
data.value: Max Levenshtein distance to treat linked readings as the same (then longer text wins, equal length keeps previous), in percent of the longer compare-key

data.name: Layout_GhostMaxFrames_Desc
data.value: How long to keep an unmatched previous paragraph visible, in frames (0 disables ghosts)

data.name: Layout_ParagraphMergeHysteresisPercent_Desc
data.value: Scale factor that loosens or tightens merge tolerances to prefer the previous frame structure, in percent of the base tolerances

data.name: Layout_SameLineWordGapHysteresisPercent_Desc
data.value: How far along the baseline to pull words that shared a previous-frame line, in percent of the word gap threshold

data.name: Layout_WordFilters_Desc
data.value: Filter OCR words before lines are built

data.name: Layout_LineFilters_Desc
data.value: Filter lines before paragraphs are built
